study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort
outcome: Brain lesions (basal ganglia and thalami, white matter, cortex, posterior limb internal capsule, corpus callosum, brainstem, cerebellum)
cohort: The study included 626 neonates with moderate or severe neonatal encephalopathy born at >=34 weeks' gestational age in French neonatal intensive care units between September 2015 and March 2017.
finding: White matter lesions predominated in preterm and early-term infants with neonatal encephalopathy, with fewer white matter lesions observed as gestational age increased.
